reason: A WeChat ClawBot channel integration that connects users to DSH Agent conversations through Tencent's documented iLink interface, with per-user sessions, local credentials, access controls, and connection renewal.

summaries.zh: 通过腾讯 iLink 微信 ClawBot 接口，将个人微信用户消息接入 DSH Agent 并返回对话回复。
summaries.en: Connects personal WeChat users to DSH Agent conversations through Tencent's iLink WeChat ClawBot interface.

capabilities: Connects to WeChat ClawBot through the iLink HTTP/JSON interface
Receives and sends text messages using long polling and message APIs
Bridges individual WeChat users to separate persistent DSH Agent sessions
Stores login credentials and session data locally
Supports QR-code login, access control, status commands, and connection renewal
